title: Cubed Chaos
description: minecraft mod that expands on minecraft 26.2 adding features that should have been added with the vanilla update
body:
# **Do you think the 26.2 Chaos Cubed update didn't add enough, Well this mod is for you!**

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ed2da51500c3051b451aa8caa1ad9eaa0ce266f.png)

In this mod we plan to expand on Minecraft 26.2 with features players wanted as well as features that just fit the update
 
The First update comes with Lava Geysers, Coloured Geysers, New Building Blocks & More!**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/RwEg_k-ZMR4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

If you have suggestions for possible future features let us know! The best place is in Belgie's Discord under the suggestions forum! - Join Belgies Discord


Huge Thanks to Centauri, TheBlockyGoat, & Admiral, Myhix, Fofurbo, Popopi for helping with the mod!
